result.response:
All tasks for Step 4 have been implemented and verified.

### Summary of Changes

1. **Model Fallback and Timeouts** ([witnessed/providers.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/witnessed/providers.py)):
   - `GEMINI_MODEL` supports a comma-separated list of models (e.g., `gemini-3.8-flash,gemini-3.5-flash`).
   - Calls iterate through models in order, falling back to the next model upon receiving HTTP 429, 500, 503, 504, or a timeout (`httpx.TimeoutException`).
   - Per-call timeout configured to 30 s via `types.HttpOptions(timeout=30000)`.
   - Recorded `model` in the `photos` SQLite table and included the `model` used alongside readings in the sealed package.
   - Added unit tests in [tests/test_providers.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/tests/test_providers.py) using mocked client errors for 429, timeout, and 503.

2. **New Check `photo_reused`** ([witnessed/checks.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/witnessed/checks.py)):
   - Implemented `check_photo_reused`: flags red with `"This exact image was already submitted in claim {other_claim_id}."` if any uploaded photo SHA-256 matches an image previously submitted under another claim; otherwise evaluates to green.
   - Connected cross-claim lookup in [app/main.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/main.py) and added test coverage in [tests/test_checks.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/tests/test_checks.py).

3. **Report Page Layout & Ordering** ([app/templates/console_claim.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/console_claim.html)):
   - Ordered top-to-bottom: Header (claim ID, status, session) → Code summary → AI summary → Findings table → Evidence photos → Seal box → Claim & policy context → Adjuster decision.
   - Sorted findings table rows by status: red first, then amber, then unchecked, then green.

4. **Narrow Screens Responsive Styling** ([app/static/style.css](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/static/style.css)):
   - For screens ≤480px, the seal box stacks vertically (text on top, full-width download button below).
   - Findings table transitions into stacked cards with check name + status pill on one row and the reason below.

5. **Photo Click Overlay** ([app/templates/console_claim.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/console_claim.html), [app/static/style.css](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/static/style.css)):
   - Added a vanilla JS lightbox overlay opened by clicking any photo thumbnail on the report page.
   - Displays full-size image, slot name, full SHA-256 hash, model used, and raw structured reading JSON; closes on Esc or backdrop/close button click.

6. **Capture Page Guidance & States** ([app/templates/capture.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/capture.html), [app/static/style.css](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/static/style.css)):
   - Shows captured frame as still preview with `"Retake (N left)"` and `"Use photo"` buttons; `"Use photo"` advances to the next slot.
   - Live video displays slot-specific light guide overlays with one-line hints:
     - `wide`: full-frame outline (*"Align whole vehicle inside the frame"*)
     - `damage`: centered square (*"Center close-up on the damaged area"*)
     - `plate`: wide short rectangle (*"Center license plate in the rectangle"*)
     - `vin`: thin long rectangle (*"Center VIN barcode or digits in the box"*)
   - Displays a `"Reading…"` status indicator during upload/reading and places a check mark (`✓`) on completed slot tabs.

7. **Fake Provider Summary Wording** ([witnessed/providers.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/witnessed/providers.py)):
   - Removed any occurrences of `"confirmed"` in canned summary responses; uses objective phrasing: *"Plate, vehicle and damage readings were compared with the policy."* and *"Flagged items need adjuster review."*

8. **Seed Updates** ([app/seed.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/seed.py)):
   - Varied colors and labels across demo claims so each has distinct images.
   - Added demo claim (d) *"Reused photo"*, whose damage image is byte-identical to claim (a)'s damage photo, triggering `photo_reused` red.

9. **Modal Deployment File** ([modal_app.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/modal_app.py)):
   - Created Debian slim Python 3.12 image installing `requirements.txt` and mounting `app/` and `witnessed/`.
   - Configured `witnessed-gemini-data` Volume mounted at `/data`, environment variables, `witnessed-gemini` Secret, `max_containers=1`, and post-write `volume.commit()` middleware.

10. **Documentation** ([README.md](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/README.md)):
    - Documented product definition, end-to-end flow, local setup with fake provider, Gemini configuration, Modal deployment, seal capabilities and limits, and "Built with" credits.

11. **Flaky Test Resolution** ([tests/test_app.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/tests/test_app.py)):
    - Fixed `_create_claim_and_get_token` token extraction to target the `capture-url-input` value instead of matching substrings in the QR code base64 data URI.
